interpretations: Compute each equipment item’s average from its nonmissing humidity readings. Use the unweighted mean of those equipment averages as the all-equipment average and as the basis for the above-average group’s mean; rank the group’s equipment by its signed difference from the group mean, including equipment below that mean if needed to fill 10 places
Compute both reference averages as unweighted means of equipment averages, but return only equipment whose average humidity is above the above-average group’s mean
Compute both reference averages as unweighted means of equipment averages, and rank the above-average equipment by the absolute size of its difference from the group mean
Use the average of all nonmissing humidity readings as the all-equipment average, then use the unweighted mean of qualifying equipment averages as the above-average group’s mean
Use the unweighted mean of equipment averages as the all-equipment average, then use the average of all nonmissing readings from qualifying equipment as the above-average group’s mean
Use averages of individual humidity readings for both the all-equipment and above-average group reference averages
Return exactly 10 equipment items when available, breaking ties in the group-mean difference by equipment reference
Return all equipment tied at the tenth-highest group-mean difference, even if that produces more than 10 rows
queries:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS equipment_avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(equipment_avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.equipref, ea.equipment_avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN all_average AS aa
    WHERE ea.equipment_avg_humidity > aa.all_equipment_avg
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(equipment_avg_humidity) AS group_avg_humidity
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    a.equipref,
    a.equipment_avg_humidity,
    aa.all_equipment_avg,
    ga.group_avg_humidity,
    a.equipment_avg_humidity - ga.group_avg_humidity AS signed_difference
FROM above_average AS a
CROSS JOIN all_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
ORDER BY signed_difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT equipref, avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
    WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)
)
SELECT equipref
FROM above_average
WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM above_average)

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
)
SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_average_group_mean
FROM equipment_averages
WHERE avg_humidity > (
    SELECT AVG(humepct)
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
)

WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
),
above_average_equipment AS (
  SELECT equipref
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
  HAVING AVG(humepct) > (SELECT all_equipment_avg FROM overall)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT all_equipment_avg FROM overall) AS all_equipment_avg,
  AVG(se.humepct) AS above_average_group_avg
FROM scanenvironment AS se
JOIN above_average_equipment AS ae ON ae.equipref = se.equipref
